scripts.build:web: corepack pnpm --filter @feelmyrythm/web exec vite build --mode mobile
scripts.sync: corepack pnpm run build:web && cap sync && corepack pnpm run verify:native-assets
scripts.sync:ios: corepack pnpm run build:web && cap sync ios && node scripts/verify-web-assets.mjs web ios/App/App/public
scripts.sync:android: corepack pnpm run build:web && cap sync android && node scripts/verify-web-assets.mjs web android/app/src/main/assets/public
scripts.archive:ios: corepack pnpm run sync:ios && sh scripts/archive-ios.sh
scripts.bundle:android: corepack pnpm run verify:android-signing && corepack pnpm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
